findings.description: The single-file wrap now checks isinstance(filename, os.PathLike), so a plain str is no longer wrapped in a tuple and is passed directly to edit_files as an iterable.
findings.rationale: Trigger: calling click.edit(filename='notes.txt') with a str. The check at line 906 is False for a str, so filename stays a str. edit_files then iterates the string character by character, opening 'n', 'o', 't', and so on as separate files. Impact: the str form of the API, which is the documented common case, opens the wrong files or errors instead of editing notes.txt.
